0022600154.text: The Orlando Magic (2-3, 9th in the East, 0-2 at home, on a W1 streak) host the Boston Celtics (4-1, 3rd in the East, 4-0 at home, on a W4 streak), with Orlando 4th in the Southeast, 0.5 games back. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain, 24.5 points per game this season), Jalen Suggs (knee, 8.0 points), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain). Boston is without Devin Carter (illness), and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with a rest designation and is a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Orlando lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 113-108 loss in Boston on April 12, 2026.
